inline.message: The function now returns n+1 dates instead of n, introducing an off‑by‑one error.
inline.suggested_fix: Change the range to range(n-1, -1, -1) so exactly n dates are produced.

summary.message: last_n_days now returns n+1 days instead of n, but no tests cover this change.
summary.suggested_fix: Add tests verifying the length and contents of the returned list for various n values.
